answer: The quill edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 8 clones produces a signature the yarrow analysis flags immediately. An adversary must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the lagoon settlement applies the void retroactively. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
